definition: The FIRST Global Challenge is a yearly robotics competition for high school students organized by the International First Committee Association.
details: It promotes STEM education and careers for youth and was created by Dean Kamen in 2016 as an expansion of FIRST, an organization with similar objectives. The competition consists of one team per country, from over 190 countries globally.
story: Picture a novelist who has read so much that, given a first line, they cannot help but write the next one. It makes new things by recombining everything it has ever seen. The result feels creative because it is memory, reshuffled at speed. It is prediction pushed forward — each next word, or pixel, guessed from everything that came before it. And that is FIRST Global Challenge — making something new out of everything it has ever seen.
